passages.note: Bill details page names Raatz as a Senate sponsor of HB 1608, which the digest describes as requiring parental notification of a name or pronoun change request.
passages.actor_quote: Sponsored by: Sen. Stacey Donato, Sen. Jeff Raatz, Sen. Gary Byrne.

passages.provision_quote: A school shall notify in writing at least one (1) parent of a student, if the student is an unemancipated minor, of a request made by the student to change the student's: (1) name; or (2) pronoun, title, or word to identify the student.
passages.note: The new chapter's only stated exceptions preserve the abuse-reporting duty and bar a confidentiality policy, so there is no staff safety exception and no consent-before-use requirement.
Senate 3rd reading roll call shows Raatz voting Yea on final passage of HB 1608.
passages.tally_quote: Yea 37 Education matters. Nay 12 Excused 1 Not Voting 0

rows.reasoning: Raatz was a Senate sponsor of HB 1608 (2023) and voted Yea on its final passage; the bill's new chapter requires that 'A school shall notify in writing at least one (1) parent of a student ... of a request made by the student to change the student's: (1) name; or (2) pronoun, title, or word to identify the student,' with no exception stated for student safety, matching 'Require staff to notify parents whenever a student asks to be treated as a different gender at school.'
